title: fix: find grouped conversations created by agents
body: Related: #147603 Related: #148533 ## What Problem This Solves A conversation created by an agent can be visible in its custom sidebar group but disappear from search and shared navigation when the user selects another conversation. Searching for its title or something said in its transcript then fails to provide a way back to that conversation. ## User Impact Grouped conversations created by agents remain discoverable through the command palette and shared session navigation after selection changes. Choosing a search result reopens the matching conversation through the existing palette entry points. Subagent runs and ungrouped spawned sessions retain their discovery exclusions. Grouping grants no access to private or incognito conversations and does not override archive, agent, cron, or system-session filters. The shared inventory rule also makes grouped ordinary conversations eligible in Activity and in `sessions_list` when subagents are excluded. Runtime ownership and parent/child relationships remain intact. ## Why This Change Was Made The palette now sends its filters to the Gateway for both metadata and transcript search. Its Gateway selector treated every entry carrying `spawnedBy` as a subagent, so changing only the browser's visibility predicate could not restore the search result. The repair narrows that existing discovery classification: actual subagent keys remain excluded, while an ordinary spawned conversation with an explicit custom group remains eligible. The shared UI navigation filter uses the same group distinction. Canonical category updates already invalidate the prepared session metadata, including archived rows, so the repair needs no new stored state, configuration, or protocol option. ## Evidence On main at `0b753f1e15b27f13252f10aaf644613f52ecac0a`, the real Gateway returned zero metadata matches for the grouped conversation's title and zero transcript matches for a unique word present in its history. The browser showed **No results found**. This fixture contains 205 newer conversations across five configured agents, so the search also has to reach beyond a recent roster window. The regression coverage uses the registered Gateway methods and the existing real-Gateway browser harness, with canonical synthetic session data and verified production UI assets. It exercises title search, transcript search, reopening a result after selection changes, and category rename/removal/restoration in the same running Gateway. Separate owner-boundary cases protect private, incognito, archived, cron, system, and transient subagent rows, plus pagination and people and owner facets. Focused remote verification is green for the candidate's Gateway, navigation, sidebar, and search-fixture code: **25 Gateway tests and 548 UI tests**. The three Gateway regressions fail on the baseline with 22 passing controls; the shared navigation regression also fails on main while its other 26 cases pass. Formatting, targeted lint, syntax, and fast static guards passed on the final content published as `5bbe6250562741620aed18b7cb12491e9c2c15f3`. Exact-head remote verification at `5bbe6250562741620aed18b7cb12491e9c2c15f3` passed all **34 selected check commands**, including production core/UI types, all 20 core test-type graphs, lint, and the applicable docs, schema, and architecture guards. The committed real-Gateway lifecycle test passed, as did the paired desktop and mobile capture scenarios against production UI assets. With another conversation selected, both title and transcript searches now find and reopen the older grouped conversation. Renaming, clearing, and restoring its category immediately update search, shared navigation, and people/owner facets in the same running Gateway. The before/after captures below use identical synthetic fixtures at 1280×900 and 390×844; the branch badge is the only intentional build-provenance difference outside the searched surface. No live provider inference or operator data is involved. ## Visual evidence []() | View | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | | Desktop title search | ![Desktop title search returns no match for the categorized agent-created conversation](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/be8a8e50-fcfa-48a2-9594-71f8e71e2c7d) | ![Desktop title search finds the categorized agent-created conversation](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/14f2fd30-622a-42e6-86ff-5d95c414065e) | | Desktop transcript search | ![Desktop transcript search returns no match for the categorized agent-created conversation](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/40bae33b-a2f3-45e3-b1a4-5e1bd5667e90) | ![Desktop transcript search finds the categorized agent-created conversation](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a535ed49-10b5-4e5a-95c0-83cf76c9ef31) | | Mobile title search | ![Mobile title search returns no match for the categorized agent-created conversation](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3c901fc1-9779-4f7d-b303-49dce26f79ca) | ![Mobile title search finds the categorized agent-created conversation](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/183c0add-7c71-49a9-a477-f0fd5723f25b) | | Mobile transcript search | ![Mobile transcript search returns no match for the categorized agent-created conversation](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2f4e8e0e-539e-43d4-b111-cbe715853764) | ![Mobile transcript search finds the categorized agent-created conversation](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9fc693e2-c5b8-4018-9cc4-052537f9353b) | ### Mobile emulation: open palette, find and reopen categorized conversation https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3633ab87-876f-46ed-8be8-6002401b619e ### Visual verification -
